biotools.summary: FLAG-X is a Python package providing novel workflows for semi-automated gating of flow cytometry data. It integrates state-of-the-art machine learning methods with manual expert annotations for identifying specific cell populations.
biotools.name: FLAG-X: Hybrid Machine Learning Workflows for Flow Cytometry Gating
